eind: Both figures in strict side profile, SEATED upright on a simple chair, feet flat. She holds ONE single dumbbell vertically with BOTH hands together around the handle (not two dumbbells, not one hand). TOP: both arms straight up overhead, dumbbell above the head, upper arms beside the ears. BOTTOM: elbows bent, upper arms still vertical beside the ears, the dumbbell lowered behind the head.

Both figures in strict side profile, SEATED on a simple chair beside a plain table. The whole forearm lies FLAT on the tabletop in BOTH figures and never lifts; only the hand sticks out past the table edge, palm facing DOWN, holding a small dumbbell. TOP: wrist straight, the hand in line with the forearm. BOTTOM: the forearm still lying flat on the table, only the WRIST bent upward so the back of the hand and the dumbbell point up toward the ceiling.
eind_r1: Both figures in strict side profile, SEATED on a simple chair beside a plain table (NOT kneeling, no stool). One forearm rests flat on the tabletop with the wrist and hand reaching past the table edge, palm facing DOWN, holding a small dumbbell; the other hand rests on the thigh. TOP: wrist straight, hand level with the forearm. BOTTOM: only the wrist bent UP so the back of the hand lifts toward the ceiling; the forearm stays flat on the table.

eind: Both figures in strict side profile, feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly out. She holds ONE long straight bar (a light stick or empty barbell, NO plates, NO medicine ball) with a wide grip, both arms straight up overhead. TOP: standing upright, arms straight overhead. BOTTOM: deep squat with thighs at or below parallel, chest up, the arms and bar still straight overhead above the head.

Both figures in strict SIDE profile. A barbell lies on the floor running FRONT-TO-BACK, PASSING BETWEEN HER LEGS: one weight plate is in FRONT of her body and the other plate is BEHIND her body, the bar goes under her crotch. Her feet are wide, one foot on the left side of the bar and one on the right side. One hand grips the bar in front of her legs, the other hand grips the bar behind her legs. TOP: knees bent in a squat, holding the bar low between the legs. BOTTOM: standing upright, the bar lifted between the legs to just below the crotch. The bar is NEVER in front of both legs.
eind_r1: Both figures in three-quarter front view. A barbell with weight plates lies on the floor between her feet, pointing from front to back; she stands with her feet wide, one foot on each side of the bar (straddling it). She holds the bar with one hand in front of her body and the other hand behind. TOP: knees bent in a squat, holding the bar near the floor between the legs. BOTTOM: standing upright, the bar lifted to just below the crotch between the legs, arms straight.

eind: Both figures in strict side profile, feet shoulder-width apart. A barbell with weight plates rests across her upper back behind the neck, both hands holding the bar just outside the shoulders (NO kettlebell, NO dumbbell). TOP: standing upright. BOTTOM: squat with hips back and down as if sitting on a chair, back straight, the bar still on the upper back.

Both figures in strict side profile, lying on the back on a DECLINE (sloping) exercise bench, head at the raised end, both hands gripping the top of the bench behind the head. TOP: both legs straight and together lying along the bench, feet at the low end. BOTTOM: both legs, still straight and together, lifted up until they point toward the ceiling (about vertical), the back stays on the bench.

Both figures in strict side profile, SEATED upright on a simple chair (NOT standing, NOT lying). TOP: sitting tall with both feet flat on the floor, hands resting on the top of one knee. BOTTOM: that knee pulled up toward the chest with both hands clasped around the shin just below the knee, the other foot stays flat on the floor, back straight.

Both figures in three-quarter front view on an exercise mat, NO strap, NO band, no equipment. TOP: deep squat with feet and knees pressed together, heels low, trunk upright, palms pressed together in front of the chest. BOTTOM: still in the same deep squat, the trunk twisted to one side, one upper arm hooked around the outside of both knees, hands reaching toward each other behind the back.

Both figures in strict side profile, lying on the back on an exercise mat, knees bent with feet flat, a small flat pillow under the head, arms relaxed beside the body. TOP: back of the head resting on the pillow, face toward the ceiling. BOTTOM: the chin is tucked firmly onto the chest and the whole head is lifted CLEARLY off the pillow, with a large visible gap (about a hand's width) between the back of the head and the pillow, as in a small head lift; the shoulders stay on the mat.
eind_r1: Both figures in strict side profile, lying on the back on an exercise mat, knees bent with feet flat, a small flat pillow under the head, arms relaxed beside the body. TOP: head resting on the pillow, face toward the ceiling. BOTTOM: chin tucked toward the chest and the head lifted CLEARLY off the pillow (a visible gap of a few centimetres between head and pillow), shoulders stay on the mat.
